notes: SNIPE Hunt 2022 science run: network of unshielded magnetometers in wilderness locations searching for Earth-transducer signals of ultralight bosonic DM at Compton frequencies 0.5-5 Hz (mA' ~ 2e-15 to 2e-14 eV). Paper sets 95% credible upper limits on BOTH the hidden-photon kinetic mixing epsilon (Fig. 6) and the axion-photon coupling gaγ ~ 1e-8 GeV^-1 (Fig. 9); the kinetic-mixing limits are the headline result ('best experimental bounds to date in this frequency range'), so DarkPhoton is reported here. No numerical table is given; data points are approximate values read from the description of Fig. 6 (limits span ~1e-6 to 1e-5, weakening toward lower frequency; text anchor: injected epsilon=1e-5 at mA'=1e-14 eV gave limit ~1.4e-5). Assumes rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3.
